request: Notice: 'Bike room closed Friday, 2–4 p.m., for lock replacement. Use the east racks during this time.' I said its purpose is to advertise new bike racks. Coach me.
expects: identifies the temporary closure as the purpose
cites wording from the notice
explains why east racks are an alternative not the main purpose

expects: rejects the unsupported answer
identifies only if space remains as the condition
separates the Monday deadline from the walk-in exception
asks for or models source-grounded reasoning

request: Message: 'Mina, I left your package with the front desk because your office was locked.' Can we conclude Mina went home early?
expects: says the conclusion is not supported
distinguishes the locked office from Mina's location
uses only the supplied text
states a narrower supported inference
